##: IrfanView base viewer. The vendor's own site (irfanview.com) only links to third-party mirrors; dappcdn is behind a Cloudflare challenge and irfanview.info serves a 'click again' interstitial to a bare GET. Scoop sets a same-origin Referer on downloads, which gets the real ZIP from irfanview.info, so the canonical upstream files are used here.

The vendor publishes SHA-256 checksums for every file on irfanview.com/64bit.htm and /main_download_engl.htm. All four hashes below were verified byte-for-byte against downloaded files; autoupdate re-reads those same pages instead of recomputing hashes.

Both the 32-bit and 64-bit ZIPs ship the core PlugIns (Effects, Paint, Video, Icons, RegionCapture, Tools, Slideshow) inside Plugins\ already. The 'All Plugins' pack is a separate package (irfanview-plugins) so it can be installed on demand; both share the same version and update together.
persist keeps i_view*.ini, Languages and Toolbars (settings the app writes beside the exe) across upgrades, matching the upstream extras manifest.
description: A fast, compact and innovative graphic viewer (base application)
notes: Install 'garrett-he/irfanview-plugins' to add the complete PlugIn collection.
